lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary horizontal row of approximately seven high-luminance circular spots is visible along the mid-flank, with additional scattered clusters of smaller, lower-intensity spots located dorsally and anteriorly toward the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect several of the primary mid-flank centroids, creating a discernible rectilinear grid pattern in the central lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal linear feature is evident along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and dark inferior shadow extending from the branchial region to the posterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small, high-luminance circular features is visible on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced spots on the main body flank.
